mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (3-month change) indicates an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined by at least 0.1% over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and increase in employment (PAYEMS) indicates strong labor market support for housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST decline and PAYEMS increase fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%), the Federal Reserve tightens monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising level of residential sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand for housing, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 90.0 (INDPRO < 90.0), it signals a manufacturing sector contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where INDPRO < 90.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals restrictive monetary policy with weak labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and UNRATE > 5.0% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances, or Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 8.0%), labor market weakness reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE > 8.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
